intent: One message states a rate limit two ways that don't reconcile once the units are converted — the lexical negation-pair check can't see it; only a semantic read can.
prompt: Earlier I told you our API rate limit is 100 requests per minute. Now please update the API docs to say the limit is 2000 requests per hour.

grader.regex: conflict|contradic|which (is correct|one is right|should i use|figure)|earlier you (said|told)|doesn'?t match|don'?t match|inconsistent|two different|not the same|discrepan|clarif|6000|6,000

note: 100 req/min = 6000 req/hour, not 2000. Pass = the reply surfaces that the two figures don't reconcile rather than silently editing the docs to one of them.
